question: ________ tribe is one of India's largest tribal groups, according to the 2011 census.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhil**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As of the 2011 census, the **Bhil are the largest tribal group in India, with a population of 4.61 million, constituting 37.7% of the total scheduled tribe population.**
 
• They are spread across the states of **Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Rajasthan, Maharashtra, Chhattisgarh, and Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• The Gond are the second largest tribal group, with a **population of 3.2 million, constituting 26.2% of the total scheduled tribe population.**
 
• They are spread across the states of **Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, and Telangana.**
